description: 从奥德胡姆拉舔开的咸冰中逐日显现的第一位神族祖先。
fullDescription: 布里是北欧创世谱系中最早出现的神族祖先。《欺骗古鲁菲》第6章描述奥德胡姆拉舔食带盐的冰块：第一日显出头发，第二日显出头，第三日完整的人形显现出来，这就是布里。文本只明确他容貌俊美、身材伟岸且强壮，并未把他描述成霜巨人、神王、战士或老人。因此本卡的核心不是蛮荒巨物感，而是‘俊美伟岸的神族祖先从咸冰中被逐步揭示’。
roleInSeries: 建立神族谱系的起点，并把奥德胡姆拉的原初生命线连接到后续神族。

sourceRefs.note: 奥德胡姆拉舔食咸冰，布里逐日显现；文本强调其俊美、伟岸、强壮。

visualThesis: 俊美、伟岸、强壮但不是巨人化的第一神族祖先，从乳白色咸冰中显现。人物已经清晰露出头、脸、肩胸与部分上身，下半身仍与冰体相连；神话感来自独特的诞生方式与祖先气质，而不是霜巨人皮肤、巨人尺度或冰火大特效。

sourceBoundFacts: 从奥德胡姆拉舔食的咸冰中逐日显现
文本评价为俊美、伟岸、强壮
interpretationNotes: 发色、年龄、胡须、服饰均非来源明确事实；当前版采用浅色长发、壮年俊美外形属于艺术设计
‘神族祖先’气质通过构图与姿态表达，不等于来源存在王冠、王座或神装
canon.worldState: 世界仍处于创世早期；不得出现成熟文明、宫殿、森林城市等后世环境。
identityAnchors: 正常神祇肌肤而非霜巨人石化皮肤
mustKeep: 头脸与肩胸位于安全区
冰中显现是第一识别点

instructions: 相对尤弥尔：缩回正常神祇尺度、俊美人形、无蛮荒巨物感
相对奥德胡姆拉：保持人形祖先与冰中显现，不复用巨兽神圣感

visual.detailHierarchy: 面部、发丝、肩胸与冰中显现边缘最高细节；冰体中等；背景低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 人物肌肤与面部边缘应明显从冰体和寒雾中分离。

prompt.draft: Búri as a fair-featured, tall and strong first divine ancestor emerging from salt-rimed primordial ice; not a frost giant, not a king, not Ymir-like.
prompt.final: Create a vertical 9:16 mythological wallpaper of Búri, the first divine ancestor in Norse creation. Depict him as a fair-featured, tall, strong, handsome adult male humanlike ancestor being revealed from massive pale salt-rimed primordial ice. The defining visual is emergence: his hair, face, shoulders and chest are already uncovered and alive, while the lower body still visually merges into the ice. He must NOT resemble Ymir: no world-scale titan proportions, no frost-giant brute anatomy, no stone-like giant skin, no huge hands reaching at the viewer, no savage old-man beard. Use normal but powerful divine-human proportions, calm ancestral dignity, clean facial structure, natural skin, and restrained pale hair. The world is still in an early creation state, so avoid mature civilization, palaces, cities, forests or ordinary pastoral scenery. The background should be mostly quiet salt-ice, frost and cold mist, with only a faint distant warm reflection; do not use a dramatic symmetric fire-versus-ice spectacle. Keep his entire head and shoulders safely centered with generous margins from all edges for future crop safety. Highest detail on face, hair and ice-emergence boundary; background simple and soft. Painterly mythic illustration, matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, restrained detail, natural imperfect edges, clear subject-background separation. No typography, logo, watermark, card frame, throne, crown, armor, weapon, random glowing runes, glossy game-CG finish or hyper-detailed-everything.
